navigation.answers: A-E click handlers write the selected letter to jawaban_UserN.text
navigation.finish: TestOver button moves option movie clip to frame 2; result screen is frame 102

timer.warning: The original SWF literally initializes timerCount to 1000 ms, which behaves like a ~1 second timer. This appears unsuitable for a real 100-question exam and should not be copied blindly into the remake.

scoring.per_question: if jawaban_UserN.text == kunci_jawabanN then correct += 1 and score += 1; otherwise wrong += 1
scoring.unanswered: empty answer is treated as wrong because it does not equal the answer key
scoring.review: result screen copies all user answers and all answer keys into review fields and marks each question state via hov_N.gotoAndStop(1 for correct, 2 for wrong)

master2: Master2.swf uses the same general 100-question exam structure and logic.
